articles.summary: PLANO, Texas (Oct. 2, 2026) –The 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross blends practical utility, surprising capability, and a stylish design that hits a sweet spot for everyday living. Heading into its sixth year in the Toyota lineup, Corolla Cross gives customers a versatile compact SUV interior, with an elevated seating position and folding rear seats to maximize cargo space. Its choice of gas or hybrid powertrains, and available front- or all-wheel drive (FWD or AWD), make it ready for the daily commute and weekend adventures alike. Style is also in the mix, with unique looks for gas or Hybrid models, seven single- and four two-tone colors, and an interior with thoughtfully designed storage and user-friendly tech.
articles.title: 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross Blends Capability, Utility and Style for the Just Right SUV

articles.summary: PLANO, Texas (Oct. 1, 2026) – Toyota is expanding the Grand Highlander lineup with the addition of the new Woodland Edition for model year 2027. The Woodland Edition adds an adventurous flair to the Grand Highlander lineup. It features details like standard all-terrain tires, an additional half inch of ground clearance, a removable cooler for keeping snacks handy while on the go, all-weather floor mats, and a cargo tray with pop-up dividers.
articles.title: Room with a View: Toyota Grand Highlander Adds Woodland Edition for 2027

articles.summary: PLANO, Texas (Oct. 1, 2026) – Toyota Motor North America (TMNA) today reported September 2026 U.S. sales of 201,306 vehicles, up 8.4 percent on a volume basis and up 4.0 percent on a daily selling rate (DSR) basis compared to September 2025. Sales of electrified vehicles for the month totaled 117,215, up 37.8 percent on a volume basis and up 32.2 percent on a DSR basis, representing 58.2 percent of total sales volume.
articles.title: Toyota Motor North America Reports September, Third Quarter 2026 U.S. Sales Results

articles.summary: SALINE, Mich. (Oct. 1, 2026) — The next chapter of Toyota’s electrification transformation begins today with the opening of the Toyota Battery Center of North America (TBC) in Saline, Michigan. The new facility gives Toyota’s Michigan-based battery teams increased capabilities to evaluate and develop technology across the full battery-development cycle, from sourcing raw materials to customer applications to recycling.
articles.title: Toyota Battery Center of North America Unveiled at Michigan R&D Campus
